customManagers.description: Track Atlas CE releases through the atlas.version pin so the differential tier follows upstream automatically

pip-compile.description: Update the SQLAlchemy fixture through its compile source so the lock and the source move in one pull request. pip_requirements sees the lock alone, which is how requirements.txt reached 2.0.54 while requirements.in still asked for 2.0.52 and the provider tier went red.

pip_requirements.description: Disabled because it would propose the same upgrade against the lock alone, next to the pip-compile pull request that carries both files. The repository has one requirements pair and pip-compile owns it.
